descriptionHtml:
Suggestion A2 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was P2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Status and errors are not announced: errors, 'no results', Ask AI answers and 'Listening…' are silent for screen readers; toggles expose no selected/pressed state

Tickets: TFA-94745 etc. · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): EFS/S22, OAT-03/S22, TC-03/S22, TC-15/S19, TC-23/S18, TC-09/S23

Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S23 Visual lane: axe, phone widths and WebKit on the Pre-Round tab, the open editor (both modes), the summary-failed message and the disabled Generate reason

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 The Pre-Round tab has two boxes: the dictation (most of the screen) and Important Points (TC-12). (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 How it works 1; TFA-92590 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr; TFA-92590 in progress
  • T2 Tapping the Pre-Round notepad opens a fullscreen editor, as in Vikram's existing app, not a fixed small box. (TFA-92588 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • T4 The summary-failed state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's style (never a blank screen, crash, raw error pop-up or invented content), loses nothing typed or dictated, appears only af … (TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT 3.5)
  • T5 The pre-round flow and its summary-failed state work on web, iOS and Android. (TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit) profiles plus desktop; Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, editor closed and open with a long text; the S12 failed state

When Run axe and the visual checks on each screen

Then No serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations; the editor dialog, notes box, points box, Dictate and Save Note have accessible names; the error is announced (role=alert); the editor fills the viewport in both modes (Nursing Home included: its editor box equals the viewport), the dictation box is the larger box, Save Note and the error stay visible, nothing …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core results (zero serious or critical) and the visual lane's overflow/covered/truncated/tap checks; the editor bounding box against the viewport (as chart.spec.ts does for Hospital); the box-height ratio feeds Q8. iOS keyboard behaviour is manual. Merged from the former S23 (axe) and S24 (phone widths and WebKit)

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Suggestion · our own check · environment local · tickets TFA-92588 ready for pr; TFA-92590 in progress; TFA-94745 ready for qa

A screen-reader user is not told when the Hospital pre-round summary fails, because the message has no alert role. The Nursing Home full-screen editor opens without being announced as a dialog, its back button has no name, and some text fails contrast.

Evidence: allure 52a4909a, visual lane: 135 passed, 39 failed across desktop, iPhone 15 and Pixel 7. The layout parts pass: the editor fills the viewport, the dictation box is the larger one, Save Note, the error and the Generate reason stay visible, and Generate's reason is a role=alert.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: visual.

UAT item: TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-10/S23

Visual lane: axe, phone widths and WebKit on the Pre-Round tab, the open editor (both modes), the summary-failed message and the disabled Generate reason

Tickets: TFA-92588 Pre-Rounding Summary (ready for pr); TFA-92590 Important Points (in progress); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane visual: status failed in visual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (visual/plan.json, automatable: partly): preround.spec.ts: processed charts (tab, editor open with the S01 text) and S12 failed charts (preRoundError seeded) in both modes: axe, names (dialog, notes, points, Dictate, Save Note), editor box vs viewport, dictation box > points box (ratio recorded for Q8), Save Note / error visible, error announced, Encounter with the disabled-Generate reason announced. [2026-10-14 review] Layout judges overflow, covered, truncated and tap (phones) on every capture: the oracle names all four (only overflow was judged before). — iOS keyboard behaviour is manual per the oracle.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 135 judged check(s) passed, 39 failed. Editor fills the viewport in both modes; the dictation box is the larger box (ratio recorded for Q8); Save Note, the error and the disabled-Generate reason stay visible; Generate is disabled on the failed charts and its reason is a role=alert in both modes.

Product issue: Hospital: the summary-failed message ('The reviewed note is saved, but its structured summary needs another attempt. Tap Save Note to retry.') is not announced — no role=alert on the Pre-Round tab or in the editor (oracle: the error is announced, role=alert; NH has it). Nursing Home: the full-screen pre-round editor is not a dialog (no role=dialog, no name), so a screen-reader user is not told a new screen opened (oracle: editor dialog … named). Also NH back button unnamed and contrast failures.

Recorded-only cells (recorded): NH editor boxes are named only by their placeholders (recorded for a person, WCAG 3.3.2; not judged — the oracle is axe). Layout checks the oracle names (overflow, covered, truncated, tap) pass on every state since the review.

Evidence: 7 attached; 1 not attached:

  • visual/evidence/TC-10_S23 — a folder (63 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
